newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Three killed by gunfire on Pakistani mosque.
newsitem.headline: Three killed by gunfire on Pakistani mosque.

text.p: Gunman attacked a Sunni sect mosque in Pakistan's Lahore city on Sunday, killing at least three men during an evening prayer congregation, police said.

There was no immediate claim of responsibility for the attack on the Chuberji Park mosque in central Lahore, capital of the central province of Punjab. But the police said the incident appeared to be the latest in a wave of attacks by rival militant groups of the majority Sunni and the minority Shi'ite sects of Islam.
Earlier in the day, a member of a militant Shi'ite group was shot dead at his office in western Lahore by two gunmen who arrived on a motorcycle, police said.
They said the attack on the mosque was carried out by six gunmen, who also arrived on motorcycles at the time of evening Maghreb prayers.
In a related development, the Punjab provincial government on Sunday decided to seize all sectarian literature, the state television said.
